title: A geometrically connected open of a fibre of a flat finitely presented map with geometrically reduced fibres spreads to geometrically connected fibres after an elementary etale base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For h : Y -> S flat of finite presentation with geometrically reduced fibres and a geometrically connected open T of the fibre Y_s, the lemma produces an affine elementary etale neighbourhood (S', s') -> (S, s) and a quasi-compact open V of Y_{S'} whose fibres are all geometrically connected with V_{s'} the base change of T. The retained proof is fully written: reduce to S affine; lift T to a quasi-compact open V of Y with V_s = T using the fibre topology (Schemes, lemma-fibre-topological); shrink to V; pick a closed point y of the fibre where h is Cohen-Macaulay (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-CM-open), cut a flat locally quasi-finite slice Z -> S with Z_s = {y} via lemma-slice-CM, make it finite locally free near s via lemma-etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-at-point, then feed the finite locally free map Z' -> Y_{S'} into lemma-descent-connected-fibres to obtain the open with geometrically connected fibres, finishing by surjectivity after shrinking S'. Retained author proof at lines 13212-13255.
